title: Explaining Models: An Empirical Study of How Explanations Impact Fairness Judgment
findings: This paper does not study, analyze, or mention religion or faith. The entire study is focused on empirically evaluating how four different styles of explanation impact people's fairness judgments of a machine learning system in the context of racial bias in criminal risk assessment.
